card.summary: A free trial of 14 days or 15 GB, whichever comes first, on all three plans, then the plan price applies. The trial signup runs through a three-step flow who...

free_tier.stated: A free trial of 14 days or 15 GB, whichever comes first, on all three plans, then the plan price applies. The trial signup runs through a three-step flow whose third step is 'Payment Information'.

per_object_cap.stated: no per-object cap is published; no per-object cap is published; the unit of retrieval is a Usenet article, approximately 750 KB by convention, so 1 TiB of monthly transfer corresponds to roughly 1.4 million article…

retention.stated: Not stated by the vendor on any page read. The trial and plans pages carry no day count; the Omicron spool this reseller serves through us.sslusenet.com is sold elsewhere as 6,642+ days, which is inferred rather than measured here.

egress.terms: Unlimited after the trial on the top plan; 35 GB and 15 GB on the two cheaper plans
egress.free_allowance: 15 GB during the trial on every plan

record.interface_detail: NNTP over TLS on port 563. No HTTP or object API exists for the download path, which is driven through SABnzbd, NZBGet or nzbdav.
record.chaining: Once the trial converts this is a second Omicron feed and adds nothing to a Newshosting or Eweka subscription; its stack value is the 14-day test window.

limits.value: 15 GB during the 14-day trial; 15 GB, 35 GB or unlimited after it

record.limits_note: Trial then $6.95/mo unlimited, $5.95/mo for 35 GB, $3.95/mo for 15 GB. The trial carries 15 GB whichever plan is chosen, so the most a free trial yields here is 15 GB once.
record.binding_note: The trial is hard-capped at 15 GB and the two cheap plans are hard-capped at 15 GB and 35 GB per month. At 1 TiB/month the counter is the first thing that fails, on every tier.

identity_cost.detail: 'Payment Information' is step 3 of the trial signup, before 'Create Login' is step 4, so a payment method is captured before the trial starts. The card is what makes this trial-only.

record.reliability_note: Omicron reseller on the sslusenet.com hosts, the same pair Newsgroup Ninja uses. The 14-day window is longer than the 3 to 7 days most competitors allow.
record.confidence_note: Trial terms, prices and step order are on the vendor's signup pages read. The card requirement is read from the step name, not from submitting the form.

evidence.proved: '14 days to test our service or 15GB of downloads, whichever comes first'; 50 SSL connections; then $6.95/$5.95/$3.95 per month
the meta description adds 'Choose the plan your account converts to after the trial'

record.notes: Documented as the clearest example of the pattern: a trial advertised as free, gated at a payment step that no vendor page describes as optional.
